source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, the home page looks great. For the services page, can we add images to the corresponding service provided? I'd like to visually show the photo, twilights, floor plan, 3d etc. With all the pages, I want them to be highly visual with images, as we are primarily a photography business. For the services page, can we get rid of the monthly and annual tabs? The pricing is one-time only pricing. Can we also add four spaces instead of 3 for the bundles? Can we also add a big diagram of the individual services that we offer? I like to be fully transparent with pricing so customers can add individual items if needed and see exactly how the pricing is broken down. I am attaching a PDF with all of the items to be included. Most of the items are also categorized by price and by the square footage of the house. I am liking the design of the gallery. The only tabs we need would be photos, twilights, videos, floor plans, and 3d tour. Maybe a smaller section for other photography because sometimes we'll take one off clients. When we do the actual website, can we make the gallery items have hover animations? The pages are looking great!

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, this is looking great! I have a couple of things. I think I found a glitch with the gallery. I've recorded a clip as follows. Could we also make the mobile version have no hover animations? I think it can be a bit jarring when the only way to hover is by touching the screen. Bonus points if we can reformat the mobile version of the pricing sheet so you don't have to scroll right to see all the info. I understand if that is too late to do, as we have already started implementing the site. Finally, can we have the buttons on the home screen direct to their corresponding pages (gallery, pricing, services)? Right now, it seems they just direct back to the top of the home page.

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text:
Hello Jordan,

Just a quick update for you.

We've updated the homepage buttons, and they now link directly to their respective pages (Gallery, Pricing, and Services).

Regarding the hover animations, this is a limitation of WordPress Elementor. If we remove the hover effects on mobile, they'll also be removed from the desktop version, as Elementor doesn't allow separate hover settings for desktop and mobile in this case.

Please let us know if you'd still like us to remove the hover effects entirely, or if you'd prefer to keep them as they are.

We're also looking forward to hearing your preference for the pricing table approach so we can implement the option that works best for you.

Thank you!

ambiguity.description: Elementor cannot disable the hover effects only on mobile under the current implementation, so the client must choose between retaining them on both mobile and desktop or removing them entirely.
